channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: UK Foreign Secretary Criticizes Home Secretary's 'English' Remarks
item.description: UK Foreign Secretary James Cleverly criticized Home Secretary Suella Braverman's remarks about individuals not being 'English'. The comments were also targeted by footballer Gary Lineker, who made a swipe at Braverman over her claim. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived in Greece to deliver a speech on democracy. He also discussed the departure of US bombers from the UK. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
